title: Database connection timeout on service A
description: Service A experienced database timeouts during peak traffic leading to errors in API responses.
root_cause: Database connection pool exhausted due to sudden traffic spike and slow queries
resolution: Increased pool size, optimized slow queries, and added monitoring

title: High memory usage in worker B
description: Worker B memory usage climbed until OOM, causing restarts and lost jobs.
root_cause: Memory leak introduced in new deserialization logic
resolution: Rolled back change and patched deserialization, added memory tests

title: Cache invalidation race in auth
description: Users experienced stale sessions due to cache invalidation race.
root_cause: Missing distributed lock during session invalidation
resolution: Added locking and retry, and updated runbook to include lock step
